payload.verdict: HELD, better than feared: with the in-repo home, .worktrees/* sits UNDER the product root - the fence covers worktree product paths BY CONSTRUCTION, no lock change needed; S4 closes for free. One wrinkle recorded for the build: a worktree's own workspace/ dir is ALSO denied (the exemption names the trunk workspace only) - harmless for this iteration's sequential mode, a build-note for the subagent future (per-root exemptions when per-tree servers arrive).
